decision: Use observed request-rate pacing and permit one recovery for explicit pre-job rate-limit rejection only.
basis: A05 and A06 final parse requests returned explicit rate-limit rejection with req/min 11 and12, remaining0, reset time; no accepted job/output identifier. Both setup and parse calls consume the observed request budget.
constraints: Complete frozen corpus with unchanged bytes/settings/references; no outcome-driven replacements.
Pace subsequent requests and respect observed reset instructions; no purchase or credential change.
One separately recorded recovery per explicitly rate-rejected input after initial sweep; retain first attempt as rate rejection.
Never retry timeout or unknown acceptance/billing state.
Final report distinguishes initial successful captures, rate-recovered captures, initial local harness failures and remaining provider failures.
protocol_interpretation: Explicit rate rejection is a proven pre-job network failure under the permitted single recovery; recorded prospectively before recovery calls.
